description: U+FEFF residual F: values beyond TEXT(255). MEMO-only table; U+FEFF then 255, 256, 500, 1000, 4000 and 8000 x, 500 euro and 100 x then euro. Asks whether the leading U+FEFF of a long Memo survives at every length (the stored form of long values differs). Rows: ID 1 m255, ID 2 m256, ID 3 m500, ID 4 m1000, ID 5 m4000, ID 6 m8000, ID 7 eur500, ID 8 x100-eur.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-wire probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
